# screetox.de

[![screetox.de](https://img.shields.io/website?url=https%3A%2F%2Fscreetox.de&up_message=online&up_color=green&down_message=offline&down_color=lightgrey&logo=data:image/png;base64,&label=screetox.de&link=https%3A%2F%2Fscreetox.de)](https://screetox.de)

A personal website featuring links, community info, and multimedia content.

## 📝 About

**screetox.de** is the online hub for the screetox community — a place to find social links, upcoming projects, and ways to connect.

## 📂 Features

- 🔗 **Social Links** – Quick access to Twitch, Discord, and more
- 🎥 **Media Content** – Highlights and short clips
- 👥 **Quiz-Tool** – Integrated [screetox/quiz-tool](https://github.com/screetox/quiz-tool)

## 🚀 Getting Started

1. Clone the repository:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/screetox/screetox.de.git
   ```
2. Open the [`index.html`](/index.html) file in a web browser.
